items.difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a closed immersion i : Z -> X of algebraic spaces over S, a morphism of ringed topoi f over i, an A-module F and a B-module G, the canonical map from F tensor_A f_*G to f_*(f^*F tensor_B G) is an isomorphism (source lines 2640-2659). The proof identifies the map as the adjoint of a map built from the identity on f^*F and the adjunction f^*f_*G -> G, then checks the isomorphism on stalks at a geometric point zbar of Z with image xbar in X, where the claim reduces to the elementary identity of tensor products F_xbar tensor_A G_zbar = (F_xbar tensor_A B_zbar) tensor_B G_zbar; the stalk computations use exactness of stalks, pullback and pushforward along a closed immersion.
